idea-plugin.name: IDEA ChatGPT Dictate
idea-plugin.description: Multilingual dictation into Codex with OpenAI speech recognition and project-aware technical term correction. Press the hotkey to start or stop recording. Text is inserted at the active composer without sending it. All configuration lives in one settings dialog, including optional recent Codex context when reliably identifiable.

action.description: Start or stop recording and insert OpenAI-recognized text into the focused chat prompt
API key, F1–F12, recognition languages, correction model and optional context
